run_bop19_pose_evaluation: run the BOP19 pose evaluation script on multiple datasets using GPU rendering with vispy
run_load_bop_results: run the script to load BOP19 pose estimation results from CSV files using inout.load_bop_results
run_subprocess_eval: run the eval_bop19_pose.py subprocess with GPU support and 10 workers for each dataset
run_timed_evaluation: run timed pose evaluation for each dataset and log execution time to output files
run_multi_dataset_evaluation: run pose evaluation across LMO, ICBIN, TUDL, YCBV, and TLESS datasets in sequence
